name: wikipedia
description: Wikipedia search and article reader via the public MediaWiki API. Search articles, fetch concise page summaries, and read full article plaintext in any Wikipedia language edition. Keyless — no credentials required.
author: Buildersoft LLC

tools.name: wikipedia.search
tools.description: Full-text search Wikipedia for articles matching a query. Returns matching page titles, plaintext snippets, and page ids.

language.description: Wikipedia language edition code, e.g. en, de, fr, es (default en)

tools.name: wikipedia.get_summary
tools.description: Get the short summary (description and lead extract) of a Wikipedia article by title.

title.description: Exact article title, e.g. Alan Turing

language.description: Wikipedia language edition code, e.g. en, de, fr, es (default en)

tools.name: wikipedia.get_article
tools.description: Get the full plaintext extract of a Wikipedia article by title. Very long extracts may be truncated.

title.description: Exact article title, e.g. Alan Turing

language.description: Wikipedia language edition code, e.g. en, de, fr, es (default en)
